mapper.insert: INSERT INTO roleplay_sessions (id, user_id, lesson_id, max_turns) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{lessonId}, #{maxTurns})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, lesson_id, max_turns, turn_count, completed_at FROM roleplay_sessions WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT turn_number, prompt_line, user_text, improved_text, tips, reply_line, provider FROM roleplay_turns WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY turn_number
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO roleplay_turns (session_id, turn_number, prompt_line, user_text, improved_text, tips, reply_line, provider) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{turn.turnNumber}, #{turn.promptLine}, #{turn.userText}, #{turn.improvedText}, #{turn.tips,typeHandler=uz.learnx.learnxapi.config.mybatis.StringListTypeHandler}, #{turn.replyLine}, #{turn.provider})
mapper.update: UPDATE roleplay_sessions SET turn_count = #{turnNumber}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{turnNumber} >= max_turns THEN #{now} ELSE completed_at END WHERE id = #{sessionId}
